run_human_agent: run the human agent to interact with a Fast Language Learning Task via keyboard controls
configure_environment_settings: create EnvironmentSettings with a seed, level name, and episode length for the task
load_environment_from_docker: load a Fast Language Learning Task environment from a Docker image using load_from_docker
map_keyboard_to_actions: map WASD arrow keys and spacebar to movement, look, and grip actions in the environment
step_environment_and_render: step the environment with actions and render RGB observations and text to a pygame window
